summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Ceragon Networks Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the release date and webcast details for its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings schedule notice with no event-driven special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. It confirms the registrant will report results on May 19, 2026, and host a conference call. No deal terms, strategic changes, or corporate actions are disclosed. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K maps to a standard earnings press release under US reporting rules. No special situation arises.
